source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: You may pay 1 **Pain token** when choosing this model to shoot in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), making it [Empowered](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain). While it is [Empowered](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain) and carrying any embarked unit, you may reroll each **Hit** roll for its ranged attacks with an [**ANTI**] weapon.
